text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober has won. She and Air<n>Groove praise
each other on a job<n>well done and vow to battle
again on<n>an even grander stage one day.

Afterward, Mejiro Dober proudly<n>declares to the
crowd that she is the<n>harbinger of a new Mejiro
era.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Everyone celebrates the light Mejiro<n>Dober and
Mejiro Bright now shine<n>as symbolic of the new
Mejiro<n>legacy.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
However, their era has only just<n>begun. The
luminous paths Mejiro<n>Dober and Mejiro Bright
walk are far<n>from having reached their ends.
